name: Basic Arithmetic Operations
description: Covers using R's arithmetic operators, including addition, multiplication, exponentiation, modulo, and integer division, to perform calculations on numbers.

name: String Manipulation
description: Introduces working with text in R by combining strings with paste and changing their case with toupper and tolower.

name: Vectors
description: Introduces creating, indexing, and summarising collections of values in R, including filtering them with logical conditions.

name: Logical Operators
description: Covers combining and negating TRUE and FALSE values with AND, OR, NOT, and XOR, alongside comparison operators and the vectorised versus short circuit forms.

name: Conditionals
description: Teaches how to make decisions in code using if, else if, and else chains so that a function returns different results depending on its input.

name: Loops
description: Teaches repeating work with for and while loops to accumulate totals, process each element of a vector, and continue until a condition is met.
